Name: Outer Titan Tesseract
Information:
**Tesseract**

Outer titan tesseracts often appear as the doom of a planet or people. Pods of outer titans scouting the galaxy will generally have a tesseract with them, which is ready to make planetfall if it encounters a planet or colony that boasts enough eidomantic life for outer titans to take notice. The tesseract is a means of invasion: they can generate gates that allow more outer titan troops to teleport onto a planet, and as long as one exists within an outer titan’s incursive forces, their numbers will never be extinguished.

When a tesseract has existed on a planet for long enough, they begin preparing to pave the path for a worldbreaker to arrive. This process takes time and energy, and is hastened by the quick spread of outer titans across a planet.

traits.name: Gate Establishment
traits.description: After the titan has established itself in a given terrain, it can connect itself to an interplanar titan hive, which learns its location and is capable of opening gates to send other titans to its location. On average it requires a week to situate itself fully, but during that time it can open small gates to deploy dustwalkers and other lesser titans. While it is situated, all titans within 10 miles of the titan are connected to it as part of a local hivemind, and the titan’s hivesense extends back to any interplanar hive it’s connected to.

traits.name: Nullification Field
traits.description: The titan projects a field of influence around it that reaches 1000 feet in every direction. Any non-titan creature that starts its turn within this field must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 2d8 necrotic damage on a failure. The terrain within this field quickly erodes into a desolate, lifeless plane if exposed to this field for too long.

actions.name: Shockwave
actions.description: Up to three creatures the titan chooses within 500 feet of it must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) psychic damage, 22 (4d10) force damage, and are knocked prone on a failed save.
